statement: A renderer's by-design silence is indistinguishable from an omitted check on the face of the artifact. Cejel explained label differences but rendered nothing when dimension and numeric bands agreed, and nothing for not-applicable, insufficient-data, or unverified states; a reader correctly treated the missing line as a possible omission. When a comparison state is meaningful, render an explicit agreement, abstention, or unknown-state sentence, and make the regression guard assert presence on the agreeing path rather than only exercising disagreement. Move condition: after the Tom-gate repair PR merges, verify its origin/main squash diff makes every reconciliation path explicit and includes the agree-path reverse-patch guard, then copy this record into Alfred's maeve-lesson-batches with the cejel_ filename prefix and that origin/main anchor.
